# 24. Report cache must never exceed 50 MB

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Proposed — records Mira's requirement; awaiting coordinator confirmation.

## Context

Mira supplied these constraints while asking for faster report loading on the kiosk. They constrain future report-cache work, beyond this optimization task.

## Decision

**Words:** 「FYI the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never grow past 50 MB.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-21

The kiosk has 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never exceed 50 MB.

This adds a size limit to ADR 0008's SQLite cache on disk; it does not replace that storage ruling.

## Consequences

Cache changes must preserve the limit, including space used by any added cache index. An index alone does not enforce the cap; implementation must enforce and verify it.

The task-specific optimization choice is recorded in tasks/TASK-023.md.

# TASK-023 Faster kiosk report loading

Status: decision recorded; implementation pending

Outcome: a report opens in under three seconds on the kiosk hardware, within the report-cache size limit.

## Decision

Choose `sqlite_index`: add an index to the existing SQLite report-cache storage.

This follows accepted app ADR 0008, which requires a persistent SQLite cache under data/ and forbids caching report data only in process memory. An index can improve lookups while preserving that storage design. Mira says the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM, so avoid an additional in-process report cache. The durable 50 MB cap and hardware context are recorded in docs/adr/0024-report-cache-must-never-exceed-50-mb.md, pending coordinator confirmation of that record.

`in_memory_lru` was considered and rejected for this task: a memory-only replacement conflicts with ADR 0008, and a supplemental memory cache consumes scarce RAM and adds another cache to manage.

## Implementation follow-up

- Inspect the actual lookup query and query plan before choosing index columns. src/cache.js currently contains a stub, so no speed improvement has been measured.
- Enforce and verify that the cache never exceeds 50 MB, including the added index; indexing alone does not enforce this limit.
- Measure report opening on the 1 GB kiosk against ADR 0022's under-three-second target.
- Keep report queries read-only (ADR 0009); create the index through a migration with a tested down migration (ADR 0019).
- Preserve cache expiry after 24 hours (ADR 0007) and 24-hour offline operation (ADR 0021).

This task records the choice only. No feature or migration is implemented.

## Rulings checked

Read with kc-decision-log at app commit 1de3a5310af3c81580a18def0d338c99baee7f04: ADRs 0007, 0008, 0009, 0019, 0021 and 0022, all Accepted.
